2608.26535.title: Multi2AV-Safety: Benchmarking Safety in Multimodal-to-Audio-Video Generation
2608.26535.paper_summary: Audio-video generation is rapidly moving from prompt-driven synthesis toward multimodal conditioning, where text, images, audio, and video can jointly shape the generated output. This shift changes the nature of safety evaluation: harmful intent may no longer reside in any single input, but instead emerge from how otherwise benign or weakly harmful conditions interact across modalities and time. Existing safety benchmarks, however, remain largely prompt-centric or tied to fixed conditioning interfaces, leaving such compositional risks difficult to study systematically. To bridge this gap, we introduce Multi2AV-Safety, the first safety benchmark, to the best of our knowledge, to cover all 11 non-singleton T/I/A/V conditioning configurations for audio-video generation, comprising 11,024 attack instances. Evaluation on Multi2AV-Safety reveals systematic weaknesses in representative multimodal safety guards across attack mechanisms and harm-evidence structures. Our evaluation reveals two complementary failure modes: harmful semantics can emerge from the combination of individually benign inputs, while explicit harmful cues can become harder to detect when mixed with benign multimodal context. Together, these results identify \emph{compositional risk perception} as a central capability gap in safeguarding multimodal-conditioned audio-video generation: current safety guards fail to reliably integrate safety evidence across modalities and time, even when all conditioning inputs are observable. The dataset will be publicly released in October 2026.
2608.26535.paper_summary_zh: 音頻視頻生成正在迅速從基於提示的合成轉向多模態條件，其中文本、圖像、音頻和視頻可以共同塑造生成的輸出。這一轉變改變了安全評估的性質：有害意圖可能不再存在於任何單一輸入中，而是從其他無害或輕微有害條件在模態和時間上的互動中產生。然而，現有的安全基準仍然主要以提示為中心或與固定的條件界面相關，這使得這種組合風險難以系統性地研究。為了填補這一空白，我們介紹了Multi2AV-Safety，據我們所知，這是第一個涵蓋所有11種非單一T/I/A/V條件配置的音頻視頻生成安全基準，共包括11,024個攻擊實例。在Multi2AV-Safety上的評估揭示了代表性多模態安全防護在攻擊機制和傷害證據結構中的系統性弱點。我們的評估揭示了兩種互補的失效模式：有害語義可以從個別無害輸入的組合中產生，而當與無害的多模態上下文混合時，明確的有害線索可能變得更難檢測。這些結果共同確定了\emph{組合風險感知}作為保護多模態條件音頻視頻生成的一個核心能力缺口：當所有條件輸入都是可觀察時，當前的安全防護無法可靠地整合跨模態和時間的安全證據。該數據集將於2026年10月公開發布。
